skill.summary: AI Agent 安全扫描器 - 通用恶意代码检测 + 多语言支持 + CLI 工具

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-security-skill-scanner.

- Provides a universal AI Agent security scanner with CLI tool (asc-scan) and multi-language support (Python, JavaScript, YAML, Go, Shell)
- Includes 183+ detection rules, risk scoring, and layered output (default/advanced/JSON)
- Offers optional environment variables (LLM/Feishu/email support) and intelligent target detection (Skill, file, NPM, GitHub)
- Transparent optional persistence: daemon, cron, and network calls with detailed security notes
- Dual repository sources (Gitee primary, GitHub mirror) for global availability
- Detailed security tips and documentation in SKILL.md
